screens.heading: Welcome
screens.body: This course covers all 128 questions on the U.S. citizenship civics test, in short lessons you can fit around your day.
The civics test is a conversation. An officer asks you questions out loud. You answer out loud. There are 128 possible questions. The officer asks up to 20.
Answer 12 correctly — you pass. The officer stops as soon as you reach 12 right. If you get 9 wrong, the test ends.
Here is a real test question. Read it, and answer out loud.

screens.heading: The question's opening words tell you what kind of answer
screens.body: The question's opening words tell you what kind of answer the officer wants.
Some answers change after elections — like the name of the President. This course shows today's answers and the date we checked them. Always check again before your interview.

bodyList: Stop anytime. The course remembers your place.
Practice out loud, in private — no one hears your mistakes.
screens.smallPrint: What you learn here is also for after the test — for reading official letters, understanding the news, and for the day you vote for the first time.
screens.privacyLine: Everything you do here stays on your phone. No one can see your practice.
